items.name: Huldra-Hair Bracelet
items.lore: A braid of hair, golden and impossibly fine. It smells of pine and cream.

items.name: Hallvard's Axe-Ring
items.lore: An iron ring forged from the head of a woodsman's axe.

items.name: Birch-Bark Sash
items.lore: Huldu work: strips of birch bark woven soft as cloth.

items.name: Grima's Hearth Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool with a red border. Old Grima's best. She insisted.

items.name: Gormr's Collar
items.lore: A wide studded collar, worn smooth by a big dog's neck.

items.name: Broken Bone-Fetish
items.lore: A vendo shaman's charm, snapped and bound with red thread. The curse is out of it. Mostly.

items.name: Houndmaster's Belt
items.lore: Hung with whistles, leads and treats. Every hound in Mularn knows it.

items.name: Spring-Water Ring
items.lore: Silver from the bottom of a cleansed spring. It is always cold.
